# Permission Management (Summary)

Source: https://hytalemodding.dev/en/docs/guides/plugin/permission-management

## Purpose
Manage player permissions and groups.

## Key concepts
- Use `PermissionsModule` for user and group permissions.
- You can add/remove permissions for users and groups.
- Users can be added to or removed from groups.
- You can query a player’s groups and check permissions.

## Extensibility
- The guide notes you can implement a custom `PermissionProvider` and add it to the provider list.
